class RHS_GadgetTouchScreenButtonWidgetComponent : RHS_TouchScreenWidgetHandler
{
	[Attribute("")]
	protected int m_iButtonNum;
	protected bool m_bButtonDown;
	protected RHS_GadgetTouchScreenWidgetComponent m_GadgetTouchScreenWidgetHandler;
	
	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	override void HandlerAttached(Widget w)
	{
		super.HandlerAttached(w);
	}
	
	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	void Init(RHS_GadgetTouchScreenWidgetComponent gadgetTouchScreenWidgetHandler)
	{
		m_GadgetTouchScreenWidgetHandler = gadgetTouchScreenWidgetHandler;
	}
	
	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	override void OnCursorDown()
	{
		super.OnCursorDown();
		
		m_GadgetTouchScreenWidgetHandler.ButtonDown(m_iButtonNum);
		m_bButtonDown = true;
	}
	
	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	override void OnCursorUp()
	{
		super.OnCursorUp();
		
		if (m_bButtonDown)
			m_GadgetTouchScreenWidgetHandler.ButtonUp(m_iButtonNum);
		m_bButtonDown = false;
	}
	
	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	override void OnUnHover()
	{
		super.OnUnHover();
		
		if (m_bButtonDown)
			m_GadgetTouchScreenWidgetHandler.ButtonUp(m_iButtonNum);
		m_bButtonDown = false;
	}
	
	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	override void OnCursorClick()
	{
		super.OnCursorClick();
		
		
	}
}
